data.title: Scotland: Sebastian Pocognoli’s ‘sad’ Hampden debut as he demands Nations League response - Sky Sports
data.content: Jack Hendry was sent off in the 3-0 defeat to Switzerland, while Scotland have failed to score in their last four games; they travel to North Macedonia in their next Nations League match on Saturday before hosting Slovenia three days later. "Even with 11 men, if we had the bad result, we would have wanted to give something, some emotion, something to analyse, something to give a direction about where we want to go, and we didn't have the chance to show it and that frustrated me a lot.". With just one point and no goals from their opening two Nations League fixtures after a 0-0 draw in Slovenia at the weekend, Pocognoli admits Scotland's next match in North Macedonia on Saturday has taken on added significance. Scotland goalkeeper Angus Gunn insists they will win and lose as a team after Jack Hendry tried to apologise for his red card in their Nations League defeat to Switzerland.

data.title: North Macedonia 0-2 Scotland (Oct 3, 2026) Game Analysis - ESPN
data.content: # Sébastien Pocognoli gets first Scotland win against North Macedonia. Sassuolo forward Kieron Bowie broke his Scotland duck with a wonder strike to set Sébastien Pocognoli on the way to his first victory as head coach on a night of landmarks in North Macedonia for the dominant visitors. The impressive Scots eased to a deserved 2-0 Nations League triumph in Skopje, ensuring a trip to the Balkans to cherish for captain Andy Robertson as he notched his 100th cap to move within two of record holder Sir Kenny Dalglish. Bowie's impressive early opener ended Scotland's 422-minute scoring drought, and it should have been the signal for the floodgates to open as they went on to spurn several opportunities to kill off their meek hosts either side of halftime. While much had been made of the fact Scotland arrived in Skopje on a run of four games without a victory, or even a goal, since defeating Haiti in their first group-stage match at the World Cup in June, North Macedonia had not previously won a match for 13 months.
